subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Technique Selection by Risk
description: A fast breakdown of Technique Selection by Risk for builders.

hook.text: A login page and a settings page both need tests. Same technique for both? Probably not. Risk decides.

buildup.text: High-risk features—payments, authentication, data processing—deserve thorough techniques like decision tables.

discovery.text: Low-risk features—static pages, tooltips—can use lighter techniques like checklists or exploratory sessions.

twist.text: Risk changes over time. A stable feature that gets a major refactor suddenly becomes high-risk again.

climax.text: Re-assessing risk each release keeps technique selection aligned with where bugs are most likely to appear.

punchline.text: Match the technique to the risk. Not everything needs heavy testing.

quiz.question: What should drive test technique selection?
